On February 17, 2024, an Eau Claire County Sheriff's deputy was monitoring traffic at a known drug hotspot motel in Eau Claire, WI, and observed a vehicle leaving the lot. It was discovered the female driver's license was suspended and she was flagged with a "Be On the Lookout" alert. Upon learning she was going to jail, she slipped out of her handcuffs in the squad car and wreaked havoc.
